name: HybridAttentionMaskPreparation
reference:
import torch

def run(batch_size, seq_length, past_key_values_length, num_attention_heads=64, swa_num_attention_heads=64, sliding_window=128):
    batch_size = int(batch_size)
    seq_length = int(seq_length)
    past_key_values_length = int(past_key_values_length)
    num_attention_heads = int(num_attention_heads)
    swa_num_attention_heads = int(swa_num_attention_heads)
    sliding_window = int(sliding_window)
    target_length = seq_length
    source_length = seq_length + past_key_values_length
    full_mask = torch.ones((target_length, source_length), dtype=torch.bool, device="npu")
    target_indices = torch.arange(target_length, device="npu")[:, None]
    source_indices = torch.arange(source_length, device="npu")[None, :]
    causal_cond = target_indices >= (source_indices - past_key_values_length)
    full_mask = full_mask.masked_fill(causal_cond, False)
    full_attention_mask = full_mask[None, None, :, :].expand(batch_size, num_attention_heads, target_length, source_length).contiguous()
    swa_mask = torch.zeros((target_length, source_length), dtype=torch.bool, device="npu")
    window_cond = (source_indices - past_key_values_length) >= (target_indices - sliding_window)
    valid_positions = causal_cond & window_cond
    swa_mask = swa_mask.masked_fill(valid_positions, True)
    sliding_window_attention_mask = swa_mask[None, None, :, :].expand(batch_size, swa_num_attention_heads, target_length, source_length).contiguous()
    return full_attention_mask, sliding_window_attention_mask
description: Prepare hybrid attention masks combining full attention and sliding window. Generates causal mask with optional sliding window restriction. Pure PyTorch: torch.triu causal mask + sliding window mask construction.
